title: Collection (draft 0.1)
description: Draft extension to discovery catalogues such as ARD's ai-catalog.json: one document that describes a group of businesses (an event, a place, an association or a marketplace). Proposal for discussion, not a standard. Field names are illustrative and may change.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the publisher's domain.

domain.description: Domain the publisher controls. Clients verify the collection is served from it.

validFrom.description: Start of the time window, for events.

validTo.description: End of the time window. Members stay reachable afterwards through their own catalogues.

facets.description: Member fields agents can filter by, such as category, priceFrom or stand.

member.description: A member business, pointing to its own catalogue, or a nested collection.

role.description: The member's place in the collection, such as stand number, category or sponsor tier.
